set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family mpls.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol community on the interface.

set protocols isis level [parameter1].explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

disable.explanation: The `disable` command in Junos deactivates a configuration statement or hierarchy, making it non-operational without removing it from the configuration.

wide-metrics-only.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

set protocols isis interface [parameter1.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

passive.explanation: Configures the ISIS protocol ' s lo0 interface to passive mode.

set protocols ldp router-id [parameter1].explanation: Configure the LDP protocol router ID.

set protocols ldp interface [parameter1].explanation: Enables the LDP protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols mpls interface [parameter1.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols rsvp interface [parameter1.explanation: The command configures RSVP (Resource Reservation Protocol) on a specific network interface (`[parameter1]`) to enable traffic engineering and bandwidth reservation.

bandwidth [parameter2].explanation: The `bandwidth [parameter2]` command in Junos sets the interface's bandwidth value to `[parameter2]` kbps, influencing routing metrics and QoS calculations.

parameters.name: bandwidth
parameters.explanation: The bandwidth value of the interface in kbps.
